definition: Removing rain streaks or drops from images and video to restore visibility — deraining for surveillance and autonomous driving.
details: Removing rain streaks or drops from images and video to restore visibility — deraining for surveillance and autonomous driving.

explainer.lead: Rain removal is the task of removing rain streaks or drops from images and video to restore visibility. It matters for surveillance and autonomous driving, where rain degrades what cameras capture.

tiers.eli5: It is cleaning up photos and video so rain streaks disappear and you can see what is behind them.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply deraining before downstream vision tasks so rain artifacts do not corrupt detection. A pitfall is that heavy processing can alter real scene detail.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as removing rain streaks or drops from images and video to restore visibility. It is applied as deraining for surveillance and autonomous driving.

explainer.example: A surveillance camera feed is derained so a vehicle in the scene is visible despite heavy streaks.
